purpose: Separate full future-trajectory information from identical present, causal history and terminal-state cues, without any policy update.
generation: Original MuJoCo least_squares plus actual nonlinear mj_step; no learned-policy scoring or model tuning during case construction. Record all rejected candidates.
primary_outcomes: Physical feasibility and matching of the full initial/terminal state, not just cart position.
Frozen-policy action difference at identical actual state, shared causal history and canonical shared endpoint.
Similarity to the two recorded first actions and the equal-cue paired-mean action-prediction lower bound.
Executed/survivor-conditioned cart tracking MAE and full-state error on immutable references.
All candidate rejections, failures, horizons and counts.
comparison_rules: No policy training, no encoder alignment, no hyperparameter search, no best-checkpoint selection.
Recorded raw endpoints are never altered; canonical shared input endpoints differ from them only by the declared tolerance and are separately labelled.
Future tail, if needed for fixed-size rolling inputs, is actually simulated under zero control; never repeat or invent missing states.
Reduced-cue frozen-policy inputs are interventions, not optimally retrained current/history/endpoint baselines.
The paired-action lower bound concerns prediction of these recorded controls, not every possible successful closed-loop control strategy.
This is a new equal-endpoint task distribution. A failure need not indicate implementation failure or CartPole insufficiency.
No formal stability, universal anticipation, humanoid or sim-to-real claim.
